title: skills(ui-merge): move the objectui skill bundle into the root skills/ catalog (decision C)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoUZLA31GTDTu7xXLQYnV3cw)_

Fixes #25832
Part of #25677 (decision C aftercare).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

**Tier H** (`skills/**`). This PR stays a draft until an authorized GOVERNED_APPROVERS review. It also carries two maintainer-only ratchet entries, listed under 维护者速读 below.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**：objectui 的技能包从 `ui/skills/objectui` 搬进仓根 `skills/objectui`，去掉 `metadata.internal: true`，`@objectstack/skills` 从此带上 `objectui` 这个技能（共 11 个）。切换 PR 里因为撞门禁被回退的 J 系列 19 号补丁在 `main` 上重新落地，读这个包的 ui 测试和脚本跟着改路径。

**为什么改**：你裁的 C 是一个技能目录服务两个产品。切换时用 `internal: true` 把包藏起来，现在从合并后的仓装技能的 agent 拿不到任何 objectui 技能。

**风险与代价（含回滚）**：

- **要你点头的第一项（token 棘轮）**：`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 新增 27 行 `CEILINGS`，每行按落地计数定价、零余量，发布目录多出 50,614 token；不抬任何已有的上限。
- **要你点头的第二项（角色词基线）**：`scripts/role-word-baseline.json` 新增 1 行 `skills/objectui/guides/auth-permissions.md: 13`。「role」保留词 38 处里改写 24 处，1 处放进 better-auth 线格式围栏，剩下 13 处是 `@object-ui/permissions` 真实 API 的 `roles` 键和 D3 改名的历史说明。
- 回滚就是 revert 本 PR，包回到 `ui/skills` 并重新隐藏。

**席位意见**：

**你要做的**：批准本 PR，就等于同意上面两项入账（27 行定价、角色词基线 1 行 13 处）。如果不同意其中一项，在评论里说明，我按你的意见改。

## What changed

- **The move (patch 19 of the cutover series, re-applied on `main`).** `git mv ui/skills/objectui skills/objectui` (27 renames). `ui/scripts/skill-bundle-root.mjs` decides where the bundle lives (the ui root in fixtures, else the monorepo root above it), and the ui gates (`check-skills-paths`, `check-skill-examples`, `check-skill-eval-tokens`, `check-doc-json-fences`, `check-shell-escape-residue`), their tests, `markdown-test-inputs`, `doc-version-claims`, `layered-read-declared-path-4016` and four package tests read it through the helper. `@objectstack/spec`'s `check-skill-examples` leaves `skills/objectui` to the ui gate, which judges it against the built `@object-ui/*` types. `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` indexes `ui/packages`, where the two identifiers the bundle cites are implemented. The one rejected hunk (`doc-version-claims.test.ts` import) was re-applied by hand, because `main` had gained a `root-ci` import there since the patch was cut.
- **`skills/objectui/SKILL.md`.** `metadata.internal: true` is removed. `compatibility:` now reads `Requires @objectstack/spec 18.x; …`, and `metadata.version` is stamped by `check-skill-compatibility-version.mjs --fix` (`2.0` → `18.1.0`).
- **Reserved word (ADR-0090 D3).** Expression examples gate on `data.status`, `user.email` or a position instead of a `role` field. The testing guide's evaluator example reads `user.position`. Prose says "positions", "grant key" or "permission checks". The `@object-ui/permissions` example renames its local array to `definitions` (the `roles` prop and keys are the package's real API and stay). `UserMenu`'s comment no longer claims it shows a role, because the component renders none. The better-auth display fields move into a fenced block marked `os:vendor-wire better-auth`. `ui/packages/permissions/src/__tests__/skill-guide-permission-config.test.tsx` pins the guide example verbatim, so it carries the same edits.
- **`visibleOn`.** `guides/schema-expressions.md`'s "Combined conditions" example uses `visibleWhen`, the canonical key in `@object-ui/types` `BaseSchema` (`visibleOn` there is `@deprecated ADR-0089 — use visibleWhen`).
- **`plugin-development.md`.** The color input passes `value ?? ''` instead of a hard-coded black hex fallback. `check:pm-skill-id-lint` read the all-decimal hex as an issue id. This keeps the epic PM's ruling on patch 19, option (a).
- **Token ratchet.** 27 `CEILINGS` rows, each pinned at its landed count with zero headroom, under a comment block that cites decision C. No existing row moves.
- **Role-word baseline.** One row was added: `"skills/objectui/guides/auth-permissions.md": 13`. The `--update` diff touches no other row.
- **Readers.** `skills/README.md` points to `./objectui/SKILL.md` instead of the objectui repository. `ui/skills-lock.json` points to `../skills/objectui`.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/skills` patch (`.changeset/25832-objectui-skill-in-catalog.md`).

## The five gates on the card, before → after

"Move" is the raw move commit `0c57048f` (patch 19 plus the flag removal, nothing else). "Head" is this PR's head.

| Gate | `main` `bbf70614` | Move `0c57048f` | Head |
|---|---|---|---|
| `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` | 0 (bundle not in `skills/`) | **1**: 27 of 91 files unpriced | **0**: 81 authored files within ceilings, 10 generator-owned |
| `… --self-test` | 0 | **1**: 2 failures (unpriced files; SKILL.md ceilings 10 vs 11) | **0**: 79 cases |
| `pnpm check:role-word` | 0 | **1**: 7 files, 38 new uses | **0** |
| `@objectstack/spec` repo test `src/ui/visibility-alias-keys-retirement.test.ts` | — | **1 failed / 11 passed** (`skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md authors "visibleOn"`) | **12 / 12** |
| `node scripts/check-ci-filter-parity.mjs` (+ `--self-test`) | 0 / 0 (120 assertions) | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0: no count to update, because `skills/**` is a `@objectstack/skills#build` input covered by `core` on `main` |
| `pnpm --filter create-objectstack test` (template-consistency "skills catalog boundary") | 0 (bundle hidden by `internal: true`) | — | **0**: 18 files / 269 tests, flag removed |

The visibility row's "before" was measured on head with only `schema-expressions.md` restored from `0c57048f`. The restore leg was checked with `git diff HEAD` (empty) and blob `9b97e3c4a6`.

Role-word split: 38 → 24 rewritten, 1 fenced (`os:vendor-wire better-auth`), 13 baselined. The 13 are `auth-permissions.md`'s `@object-ui/permissions` API (`ObjectPermissionConfig.roles`, the `roles` prop and keys, about 9 uses) and the paragraph recording the D3 `roles` → `positions` retirement (4 uses).

## `skills/**` readings (lines are the measure; token counts from the ratchet's convention)

- **Whole bundle:** 5428 → 5434 lines (+6). `auth-permissions.md` 409 → 416 (the vendor-wire fence). `SKILL.md` 143 → 142 (the `internal` line). The other 25 files are unchanged in length. Raw bytes/4 50582 → 50619.
- **Changed files:** `SKILL.md`, `guides/architecture.md`, `guides/auth-permissions.md`, `guides/page-builder.md`, `guides/plugin-development.md`, `guides/schema-expressions.md`, `guides/testing.md` and `rules/protocol.md`. All except the two above keep their line count. `skills/README.md` stays at 133 → 133.
- **Catalog SKILL.md sum:** 4383 → 4525 lines (+142, the objectui `SKILL.md`).
- **Priced catalog:** ratcheted subtotal +50,614 tokens (the 27 new rows). Bundle total 206,118 tokens. The `@objectstack/skills` build copies 92 files across 11 skills.

## Verification (head 12e779cd)

- `skills` CLI: `npx skills@1.7.2 add ./skills --list` → "Found 11 skills", `objectui` listed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/skills build` → 92 files across 11 skills, read back byte-identical.
- Skills family: `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-top-level-keys`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` 0. `@objectstack/spec` `check:skill-refs`, `check:skill-docs`, `check:skill-examples` 0 (after `@objectstack/spec` and the `client-react` / `client` closures were built).
- ui gates (`ui/scripts`): `check-skills-paths`, `check-skill-examples` (after the scoped build its `--build-filter` names), `check-skill-eval-tokens`, `check-doc-json-fences`, `check-shell-escape-residue` all 0.
- ui tests: `ui/scripts/__tests__/` 180 files passed, 2 skipped / 5273 tests passed. The 14 package test files that read the bundle: 159/159.

**Derived gates (head `12e779cd`):** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 107 families (100 commands at `67d25683` plus 7 changeset-family commands after the changeset commit). 106 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 107 of 107 accounted, 0 unrun. `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` first exited 3 because its pinned commit `621a4876` was missing from the shallow clone. After `git fetch origin 621a4876… --depth=1` it exits 0 (48 cases). **NOT MEASURED:** `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3 (prerequisite: every published package needs a `dist/`, so it needs a full workspace build). The diff changes no package's build output except `@objectstack/skills`' copied catalog, so it is left to CI's Lint & Repo Gates.

**Push-environment battery (head `12e779cd`):** `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=push node scripts/pm/check-dispatch-gates.mjs`: 2182 cases pass (1901 fast + 265 slow = 2166 partitioned, plus the census), 0 failed, exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- **The generated catalog index omits `objectui`.** `packages/spec/scripts/build-skill-docs.ts` admits only `objectstack-*` directories, so the `skills/README.md` index table and the skills-reference page list 10 skills. The CLI, the package and the README's hand-written routing line all see 11. Admitting a non-`objectstack-` skill there is a generator change, outside this card. Carrier: the epic PM.
- **A `skills/objectui/**`-only PR does not trigger the ui lanes.** The ci.yml `filter` job's `ui` glob is `ui/**`, so the ui skill gates ported into Lint UI no longer see the bundle's own edits. This is bill item 35. Its owner is the 4b ci.yml work (#25712, Tier H). This PR does not touch `.github/workflows/**`.
- **The `ui/skills/**` register row is now empty.** `GOVERNED_SURFACES`, the CODEOWNERS `/ui/skills/` line and AGENTS.md Prime Directive #14 still name `ui/skills/**`. The root `skills/**` row governs the bundle now. Dropping the row is an AGENTS.md / pm-dispatch SKILL.md edit at zero line headroom, so it is left to the 4b governance rewrite.
- **`@object-ui/permissions` still spells its grant keys `roles`.** That is objectui's own API, older than ADR-0090 D3. Renaming it is a code change, not a guide change, and the 13 baselined uses go away with it.
